pointwise_primary_bound.notation: P=neighbor difference of captured p_pert; A=neighbor sum captured alt; B=neighbor difference fixed p_base; E_p,E_a,E_l are per-cell Linf errors of native p_pert, alt, al_pert versus chosen same-state real EOS. Deltas are signed errors; each difference or sum involves at most two terms.
pointwise_primary_bound.physical_rate_coefficient: C_face=abs(0.5*spacing_inverse*map_ratio*level_mass*cq_face/alpha_face), so primary U or V physical-rate sensitivity <= C_face times bracket in exact arithmetic. For fixed finite nonzero canonical alpha and unguarded map ratios it simplifies algebraically to abs(0.5*rdx*msfux*cqu_face) for U and abs(0.5*rdy*msfvy*cqv_face) for V; verify actual map guards/cq and domain before cancellation.
pointwise_primary_bound.important: U uses alt sums directly; V uses 2*face averages, so bound on resulting sum coefficients must follow actual avg_y_to_v boundary stencils, not assume interior at every face. Q is a copy/reflection/zero map, so its infinity norm <=1 for each block under this topology.

packed_norm_bound.condition: Given valid max component errors Bu,Bv after primary physical-rate conversion and Q, fixed positive stored S_inv, identity H, total packed N and block element counts nu,nv
packed_norm_bound.formula: sqrt(nu*(max_u_Sinv*Bu)^2 + nv*(max_v_Sinv*Bv)^2)/sqrt(N); a norm bound for these U/V terms only, before adding other components and independently certified floating arithmetic/conversion/norm error
packed_norm_bound.limitation: Observed receipt contains S_inv hash, not the S_inv array or values; cannot substitute guessed scales. If masks or scaling vary, use their actual actions.
